sources: Borough metadata: curated from public New York City sources
Crime: NYPD CompStat-derived offence rates per 1,000, against New York City population denominators
Prices: curated New York borough median sale prices, in USD

Aviation noise context: ESTIMATED from the FAA routes of JFK, LaGuardia, Newark and Teterboro, fitted to the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey noise-monitor readings for January-July 2026; NOT a measurement at this address
Borough aircraft band: the same estimate averaged over residents by 2020 ZIP Code Tabulation Area, weighted by US Census Bureau ACS 2020-2024 population (public domain)
Licence note: Open Government Licence v3.0 covers UK Crown copyright and does NOT apply to any data in this response
Flight routes: FAA Coded Instrument Flight Procedures, derived by Sky Score for the aircraft noise estimate; supplied "as is", without warranty, and not for navigation
Runway use: counted by Sky Score from aircraft positions via adsb.lol (ODbL 1.0), 2026-01-01 to 2026-07-30; the counts are offered under the ODbL

sourceBreakdown.quiet: ESTIMATED from the FAA's coded routes of JFK, LaGuardia, Newark and Teterboro: the runway directions flown at least 10% of the time (counted from aircraft positions), with each airport's size and the route weight fitted to the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey's noise-monitor readings for January-July 2026, so that at every airport the estimate reads louder than its monitors on average. Runway use is counted over the monitors' own months (every third day, January-July 2026), and each flown direction counts as a runway strip for 15 km out from the airport, the coded routes beyond. NOT DEFRA and not a measurement at this address: no published Lden survey covers New York, so the dB thresholds in METHODOLOGY section 3 are not directly applicable. A borough query reads a band derived from the same estimate, averaged over the borough's residents. The chosen resolution is reported in context.quietResolution.
sourceBreakdown.afford: Curated New York borough median sale prices (USD). NOT HM Land Registry, which holds England and Wales only. Methodology v5.0 scores this on a LOG scale against the 5th-95th percentile of the USD pool (USD 446,000 to USD 1,130,000). Stated plainly: that pool is New York's 5 boroughs, because New York is the only city Sky Score covers outside the United Kingdom - so this is a within-New-York scale, and it is NOT comparable with the sterling scores, which are anchored on a 97-borough national pool. Prices in different currencies are not pooled.
sourceBreakdown.live: NYPD CompStat-derived crime rates with New York population denominators, plus curated school / transport / healthcare tiers. NOT ONS, Home Office, DfE, TfL or NHS — none has a New York remit. Cross-city comparison against UK boroughs should be approached with caution: different collection methodologies.
sourceBreakdown.env: NOT scored for this city. DEFRA and the Environment Agency publish for the UK only, so no environment input is available here.
sourceBreakdown.growth: Curated New York borough annualised price trend, NOMINAL. NOT HM Land Registry HPI, and not deflated: no US inflation series is held, and dividing dollars by a UK index would be a number nobody measured. context.growthBasis says so. Cohort-relative among the 5 New York boroughs - the USD pool is exactly them. A previous vintage exists, so ?compare=previous reports real movement.
